title: At-Risk Hold on Retired Points When a Seller Performance Standing Account Closes
content:
**Hold.** The at-risk hold is the warning-band hold of 2 points for a seller whose record is at risk and whose active points at closing are at or above the warning points threshold of the seller's level, the at-risk hold of 1 point for a seller whose record is at risk with active points at closing below that threshold, and nothing for a seller in good standing.

The warning points threshold of Seller Performance Standing is 8 points at every level. The active points at closing are the points of every violation recorded on the standing record less every point reversed, expired, stepped down or relieved. When the seller closes the selling account, the hold is subtracted from the retired points after they have been rounded down to a whole point; the result never falls below zero, and the retirement cap then limits it.

## Decision table

| Status of the standing record at closing | Active points at closing | At-risk hold |
|---|---|---|
| at risk | 8 or more | 2 points |
| at risk | 7 or fewer | 1 point |
| good standing | any | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An at-risk record with exactly 8 active points at closing: 8 is at the threshold, so the hold is 2 points.
- An at-risk record with 7 active points at closing: the hold is 1 point.
- A record in good standing with 12 active points at closing: no hold.
- Rounded-down retired points of 3 with an at-risk hold of 2 leave 1; rounded-down retired points of 1 with the same hold leave zero, not a negative number.
